newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Providian Financial started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Providian Financial started.

text.p: Jeffries & Co said on Wendnesday it initiated coverage of Providian Financial Corp with a buy rating and a $38 per share target, as the company was an undervalued play in the secured credit card businss.
-- Analyst Charlotte Chamberlain said in a research note her 1997 earnings estimate was $2.00 per share and her 1998 estimate was $2.35 per share.
-- "Providian has the market finesse, pricing discipline and earnings growth to rank with the best of the 'pure card' issuers," she said.
-- Its shares would start trading on a when-issued basis soon, she said.
